title: From Old to New: Chains of Transformation

sets.relationshipLabel: early technology evolves into a refined modern successor
sets.explanation: Each pair shows an early tool or medium being refined into its modern, more capable form.

sets.relationshipLabel: old form of rule or status transforms into a new political form
sets.explanation: A colony becomes a nation and a monarchy becomes a republic — each pair marks a shift from an old political condition to a new one.

sets.relationshipLabel: a new technology enables the rise of a large-scale societal force
sets.explanation: The printing press fueled the Reformation and gunpowder fueled imperial expansion — each invention unlocked a sweeping historical movement.

sets.relationshipLabel: an early economic system or network gives way to its modern equivalent
sets.explanation: Feudalism gave rise to capitalism and the Silk Road gave rise to globalization — each pair traces an early economic structure into its contemporary descendant.
